verdict.rationale: Substantive text was extracted from many public guidance pages on sos.wa.gov and dor.wa.gov, such as business-formation, closure, apostille and licensing guidance. That implies the reading surface served real HTML content rather than a bot wall or JS-only shell. The only probe showing a JS application shell hit the secure.dor.wa.gov transactional tax portal, not the public guidance pages, so it does not contradict this. missing for 10: an explicit keyless probe of the sos.wa.gov guidance pages recording HTTP status, user agent used, and absence of CAPTCHA/bot challenge; independent corroboration of agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
